key_fields.character_source: Multiple fighters including Future Warrior; Nuova Shenron
key_fields.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific evidence classifies Charged Ki Wave as an Other Super using 100 Ki. It restores Stamina by consuming Ki and completes faster than Rise to Action. PQ97 is the Future Warrior acquisition route.

Current skill-specific evidence classifies Phantom Fist as an Other Super using 100 Ki. It functions as an afterimage-style evasive state; successfully evading an attack restores roughly 100 Stamina. PQ97 is the Future Warrior acquisition route.
Current Xenoverse 2 skill references classify Bluff Kamehameha as an Other Super using 100 Ki; it is a deceptive Kamehameha-style utility skill rather than a conventional damaging beam.

Current Future Warrior technique references identify Emperor's Edge as Golden Frieza's Super Skill and place it among Frieza-style Death Wave variants. PQ99 is the base-game acquisition endpoint in the maintained reward transcription.

Current Future Warrior technique references identify x100 Big Bang Kamehameha as Gogeta's Ultimate Skill. PQ100 is the maintained base-game acquisition endpoint; the TP Medal Shop is also an acquisition route in current technique documentation.
